00064 /* Macro for disabling copy construtor and assignment opterator */
00065 
00066 #define DISABLE_COPY(classname) \
00067    private: \
00068       classname(const classname &); \
00069       classname &operator=(const classname &)
00070 
00071 #define OVERRIDE_NEW \
00072    public: \
00073       static void *operator new(size_t size) { return XALLOC(size); } \
00074       static void operator delete(void *ptr) { XDEALLOC(ptr); }
00075 
00076 #define SIMPLE_OBJECT(classname) \
00077    OVERRIDE_NEW \
00078    DISABLE_COPY(classname)
